Acquisition by Hatzfeldt of the privately owned properties of the late Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg.

Date span: 1640, 1653–1656.

Contents: 1. Purchase by Bishop Franz von Hatzfeld, on behalf of his brothers Melchior and Hermann, of the privately owned properties of the late Albrecht Christoph von Rosenberg in the bailiwicks of Rosenberg, Haltenbergstetten, Unterschüpf and Waldmannshofen for 55,000 Reichstaler (authenticated copy), 1640 (1661).
2. Receipt by the Rosenberg property heirs for 55,000 Reichstaler (copy), 1653.
3. Release of the Counts von Hatzfeldt by the sellers from claims concerning the purchased Rosenberg properties (warranty against eviction) (original), 1656.

Extent: 1 volume.
